turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! First I will work through one example and say my thinking.
Sentence: He found ___ egg. I look at the next word, "egg". I say it: the first sound is "e", a vowel sound. So the answer is "an": He found an egg.
Rule: "an" goes before a vowel sound, "a" before other sounds.
Right: He found a key. Wrong: He found an key.
Your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
